question: Pharma excipient invoice from Sai Associates Pvt Ltd, batch in quarantine — does it need QA release?

rule.text: Yes — for Arvana Pharma, an excipient invoice cannot be paid until the batch shows status Released in the Quality Management System (QMS), and this applies to excipients without exception. [1] Check the batch number on the GRN against QMS, and because the batch is in Quarantine, raise the QA_RELEASE_PENDING exception. [1] QA_RELEASE_PENDING means 'Pharma batch not released (CM-PHA-01)', its owner is Client QA, and the target is to resolve it before the due date. [2] The invoice may be posted, but the payment block stays until the batch is released. [1] In practice, colleagues raise QA_RELEASE_PENDING when they find a pharma batch in Quarantine in QMS. [3]

question: Infra invoice from Vertex Enterprises has no GRN since Saturday, should I raise NO_GRN now?

rule.text: Yes — a goods invoice with no GRN must be held as NO_GRN, and the system notifies the requester automatically. [1] The Requester owns NO_GRN exceptions, with a target to resolve of 5 working days; the system sends a reminder after two working days and escalates to the requester's manager after five working days. [2][1] Do not post the goods invoice against a PO without a GRN, whatever the requester says on the phone. [1] In practice, Infra sites batch their GRNs on Monday morning, so anything that comes in Friday to Sunday is waited on until Tuesday noon. [3]

question: Is INV/0102 same as INV809-REV from Metro Distributors?

rule.text: The evidence does not establish that INV/0102 and INV809-REV are the same invoice: normalisation removes spaces, slashes, hyphens and leading zeros and drops a trailing -REV, so the two numbers must be compared on that normalised basis rather than assumed equal. [1] The duplicate check is the first step, before indexing, and compares every invoice with invoices received in the last 18 months for the same supplier. [2][1] Two invoices are a suspected duplicate when the supplier GSTIN and normalised number match, or when the supplier, invoice date and total amount (within ₹1) match. [1] Suspected duplicates go to the exception queue as DUP_SUSPECT and are never posted until a Senior Processor clears them. [1] In practice, suppliers resend invoices all the time and the system normalises the number so that 'INV/0042' and 'INV42-REV' look the same to it, and if it flags amber you stop. [2]

question: Balaji Logistics Pvt Ltd invoice not showing in 2B — hold full amount or only GST?

rule.text: Hold only the GST amount, not the full amount: pay the base value on the due date and hold the GST until the invoice appears in GSTR-2B. [1] GSTR-2B for a month is generated on the 14th of the following month, and input tax credit is claimed only for invoices that appear in the client's GSTR-2B. [1] If the invoice is still missing after two further GSTR-2B cycles, raise NOT_IN_2B to the vendor relationship owner. [1] In practice, check whether the supplier is a quarterly filer under QRMP before chasing, since the vendor master has a QRMP flag and chasing a QRMP supplier in month one or two of a quarter is pointless. [2]

question: Price diff of ₹820 on a ₹30,000 line for Apex Associates Pvt Ltd — can I pass it or PRICE_VAR?

rule.text: No — the ₹820 excess on a ₹30,000 line cannot be passed; the line must be held with exception PRICE_VAR. [1][2] A line passes only if the total excess is no more than the lower of 1% of the PO line value and ₹500, and 1% of ₹30,000 is ₹300, so ₹820 is above the limit. [1][2] The held line is sent to the PO buyer who raised the PO, and the buyer either amends the PO or asks the supplier for a credit note. [1] PRICE_VAR is owned by the PO buyer and must be resolved within 3 working days. [3] In practice, new joiners often apply ₹500 without checking 1% first, which is a common source of PRICE_VAR rework. [2][4]

question: Which TDS section for Metro Distributors's HVAC AMC?

rule.text: For Metro Distributors's HVAC AMC, the section depends on what the contract mostly supplies: mainly manpower and repairs falls under section 194C, while mainly technical or software support falls under section 194J at 2%. [1] If the AMC contract is mixed or unclear, raise the TDS_SECTION_UNCLEAR exception to the Tax Desk and do not guess the section. [1] When posting, open the TDS tab, take the section the vendor master suggests, and check it against the nature of the service on the invoice; if the suggestion and the invoice disagree, raise TDS_SECTION_UNCLEAR. [2] In practice, colleagues leave the vendor master's suggestion unchanged and raise TDS_SECTION_UNCLEAR, noting that the Tax Desk usually says 194C for a lift AMC but that it is their call. [3]

question: Metro Agencies Pvt Ltd wants to change bank account, they mailed from their registered id. Can I send for approval?

rule.text: No — an e-mail from the registered id is not enough, because the supplier must send a request on letterhead signed by an authorised signatory, with a cancelled cheque for the new account. [1][2] The Vendor Master team must call the supplier on the phone number already held in the vendor master — never on a number given in the request — and confirm the change with a named person, recording the call (time, person, outcome) in the change ticket. [3][4] Once verified, send for approval to the Vendor Master lead and then the AP Controller, as the change is approved by both. [5][6] The ERP then blocks payments to the new account for 24 hours after the second approval, and you must not ask IT to lift the block. [7] In practice, colleagues treat bank account changes as a fraud risk and call back on the number already held rather than any number in the request. [8][9]

question: Courier invoice from Apex Associates has no PO — can I post as non-PO?

rule.text: No — a courier invoice cannot be posted as non-PO, because courier and travel-agency invoices, which were non-PO under version 3.1, now require a purchase order. [1][2] Only electricity, water and telecom utilities; store and office rent under a registered lease; statutory payments and government fees; and insurance premiums may be processed without a PO, and every other invoice needs a PO. [1] A non-PO invoice outside 4.5 is held under exception code NON_PO_NOT_ALLOWED, which the Requester owns with a target to resolve of 5 working days. [3]

question: Balaji Logistics Pvt Ltd is MSME (small) — is due date 45 days or 60?

rule.text: For a micro or small enterprise like Balaji Logistics Pvt Ltd, the due date is the agreed term, which can never exceed 45 days from the day of acceptance — not 60 days. [1] If there is no written agreement on terms, payment must be made within 15 days from acceptance. [1] The 60-day default applies only to suppliers that are not micro or small enterprises, unless the PO says otherwise. [1] An MSME_DUE flag means a micro/small supplier is within 7 days of the due date; it is owned by the Team Lead with a target to resolve before the due date. [2] In practice, if a micro or small supplier is within seven days of the due date and still stuck, escalate it to senior processor Sandeep that same day. [3]
